purpose: Turn the black-hole thermodynamics/Mpemba heuristic into separable analytic, theoretical, observational and falsification routes without promoting analogy to evidence.
epistemic_invariants: holographic or Unruh Mpemba precedent != astrophysical black-hole Mpemba detection
static Tolman temperature != freely falling thermometer reading
jet-launching region outside the horizon != matter escaping from inside the horizon
failed descendants are quarantined, not deleted

mpemba_operational_definition.distance: D[X(t), X_eq] must be fixed before inspecting the crossing
mpemba_operational_definition.anti_post_hoc_rule: epsilon, observable, preprocessing and covariance treatment must be preregistered for a real-data claim
mpemba_operational_definition.mode_mechanism_probe: compare overlap/amplitude of the slowest relaxation mode; suppression in the farther state is a candidate mechanism, not a universal necessity

claim_ledger.claim: For a Schwarzschild black hole, T_H is proportional to M^-1, S_BH to M^2, and C_BH is negative.
Static Tolman near-horizon temperature is equivalent to the temperature measured by a freely falling observer.
Past, present and future coexist as one locally measured thermodynamic state at the horizon.
Observed jets consist of material emitted from inside the event horizon.
Magnetized exterior plasma and black-hole spin/flux are physically relevant to relativistic jet launching.
An astrophysical black hole has a directly observed Mpemba relaxation.
Mpemba-like relaxation has rigorous quantum/non-equilibrium and gravitational/holographic precedents.
Hawking temperature has been directly measured for M87* or Sgr A*.
Generic curved spacetime always supplies one globally conserved scalar energy for the complete system.

falsifiers.criterion: dT_H/dM < 0, C_BH < 0, T_H(2M)/T_H(M)=1/2, S_BH(2M)/S_BH(M)=4 within the Schwarzschild semiclassical domain
observer class must be explicit and the static formula must reject r <= r_s
any model requiring causal transport from inside the horizon to infinity is rejected
confront exterior jet model with horizon-scale polarimetry, jet-base morphology and standard GRMHD/force-free competitors
matched time series must satisfy far initial distance, crossing and faster first-passage conditions
effect must survive covariance, uncertainty propagation, alternate monotone distances and hold-out analysis
remove/postpone the candidate slowest mode; if the inversion disappears, mode suppression gains mechanistic support
holographic, Unruh and quantum-system evidence must remain source-class labelled
never use EHT synchrotron/plasma emission temperature as a Hawking-temperature measurement
